explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Miao Rebellion (1854–1873)" (revision 1370628188) says: "The eruption of the Taiping Rebellion led the Qing government to increase taxation, and to simultaneously withdraw troops from the already restive region, thus allowing a rebellion to unfold." The edge reads that sentence as: Taiping Rebellion made Miao Rebellion (1854–1873) possible, and nothing more.
